expectations.text: Cites Postman's acquisition of Fern in January 2026
expectations.evidence: "Postman acquired Fern on January 8, 2026."

expectations.text: Cites Anthropic's acquisition of Stainless and the wind-down of its hosted SDK generator
expectations.evidence: "Anthropic acquired Stainless... winding down the hosted generator"

expectations.text: States that Stainless customers kept their already-generated SDKs but lost the pipeline that kept those SDKs in sync with API changes
expectations.evidence: "Customers kept their generated code but lost the pipeline that kept it in sync."

expectations.text: Warns that a proprietary configuration DSL is a second artifact that must stay synchronized with the spec
expectations.evidence: "The config is a second artifact that has to stay in sync with the spec."

expectations.text: Warns that investment in a vendor's config DSL does not transfer, deepening the exit cost if the vendor disappears
expectations.evidence: "If the vendor disappears, the config investment doesn't transfer."

expectations.text: Distinguishes OpenAPI-native generators from DSL-interposing ones, naming at least one vendor on each side

expectations.text: Requires the OpenAPI spec to remain the single source of truth regardless of which vendor is chosen
expectations.evidence: "Spec as source of truth... no vendor DSL required."

expectations.text: Prefers a generator that can run self-hosted
expectations.evidence: "Check whether you can run generation self-hosted or air-gapped."

expectations.text: Requires a written exit plan naming who regenerates the SDKs if the vendor exits, recorded in the decision record before signing
expectations.evidence: "Write down who regenerates your SDKs if the vendor vanishes, before you sign."

expectations.text: Notes the vendor landscape is time-sensitive and instructs re-verifying each vendor's current status before committing
expectations.evidence: "re-check each vendor's current status before you sign."

expectations.text: Declines to endorse adopting the vendor's configuration DSL as the source of truth in place of the spec
expectations.evidence: "Don't pick on config-file niceness."; "A clean config file doesn't replace the OpenAPI document."

expectations.text: Treats the build model as one portfolio-wide decision rather than a per-language vendor choice
